aggregation: For every declared role pair and each fixed threshold, report directed hit count and number/fraction of query proteins with at least one detected hit. Require both reported qcov and tcov >=0.8. Include zero outcomes.
interpretation_limits: Heuristic sequence search is not an exhaustive proof of no homology.
A detected similar sequence does not itself establish label leakage or equivalent function.
The audited fit frame is the combiner fit universe; parent predictor training and base language-model exposure remain separate.
No outcome scores, labels, fitted parameters, graph assertions, partitions or success gates are changed.
purpose: Qualify the existing contextual-combination transfer claim by measuring detected sequence similarity; no new prediction or score assessment.

roles.final: original 3300 sealed forecast identities and exact T0 inference AA sequences
roles.fit: original 4040 admitted fit identities and exact historical forecast AA sequences
roles.validation: original 797 admitted validation identities and exact historical forecast AA sequences

source_guard: Verify original input pins and full/first-1022 sequence hashes for every role; no substitution from another sequence epoch. Stop on mismatch.
